设计意图： Mutation of the crossover parent to improve payoff stability. Using a longer 40-day window for volatility asymmetry reduces noise and produces a more persistent signal, which improves the consistency of the leverage effect across market cycles. The momentum gate attenuation is slightly reduced to 0.8 (from 0.7) to allow more signal during high-momentum regimes, as the longer window already provide

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

修复版 DSL（2026-08-29 低相关诊断修正，parse 验证通过）
downside_vol = ts_std(40, neg_returns); upside_vol = ts_std(40, pos_returns); raw = downside_vol - upside_vol; if high_momentum then raw * 0.8 else raw
依赖列: close, style_gate_momentum_high

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)) > 1), multiply(subtract(ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40), ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40)), 0.8), subtract(ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40), ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40)))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21))
  3. 3. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40), ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40)), 0.8)
  5. 5. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40), ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40))
  6. 6. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40)
  7. 7. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  8. 8. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40)
  9. 9. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  10. 10. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40), ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40))
  11. 11. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) minimum 0), 40)
  12. 12. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  13. 13. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) maximum 0), 40)
  14. 14. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 pos_ret：ret.clip(lower=0)
  3. 计算 neg_ret：ret.clip(upper=0)
  4. 计算 downside_vol：neg_ret.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).std()
  5. 计算 upside_vol：pos_ret.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).std()
  6. 计算 raw_asym：downside_vol - upside_vol
  7. 计算 high_mom：style_gate_momentum_high > 0
  8. 计算 factor：np.where(high_mom, raw_asym * 0.8, raw_asym)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_vol_persistence_momentum_gated_longer(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() pos_ret = ret.clip(lower=0) neg_ret = ret.clip(upper=0) downside_vol = neg_ret.rolling(40, min_periods=40).std() upside_vol = pos_ret.rolling(40, min_periods=40).std() raw_asym = downside_vol - upside_vol high_mom = df_copy["style_gate_momentum_high"] > 0 factor = np.where(high_mom, raw_asym * 0.8, raw_asym) df_copy["factor_downside_vol_persistence_momentum_gated_longer"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_downside_vol_persistence_momentum_gated_longer"]
